cards.text:
V-TD08/001EN
Full Full Appeal, Farlull
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[CONT](VC):If you called a rear-guard this turn, this unit gets [Power] +5000.
[ACT](VC)[1/turn]:[COST][Counter-Blast 1], this unit gets [Power] +15000 until end of turn, and if you have five rear-guards, draw a card.

V-TD08/002EN
Graceful Prayer, Amie
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[AUTO](VC/RC):When it attacks a vanguard, if you have five rear-guards, this unit gets [Power] +15000 until end of that battle.

V-TD08/003EN
Choco Love Heart, Liselotte
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[CONT](Hand):It can be called as a grade 1. (Can be called to (RC) even when your vanguard is grade 1. Is grade 2 after being placed)
[AUTO](VC/RC):When placed, look at the top card of your deck, and call it to (RC) or put it into your soul. This ability may only be used by a card with the same card name once a turn.
